in_marathi.name: Champak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Champak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Champak means 'golden flower'. This name is derived from the Champaka tree, whose fragrant flowers are yellow and are considered auspicious in Hinduism. The name signifies beauty, prosperity, and grace.
